summary: Iter 14 verified the rebuilt Super-Admin SaaS analytics console. Backend 21/21 PASSED on test_iter14_superadmin.py — covered auth/access (owner & unauth get 403/401 on /api/admin/analytics and /api/admin/gyms), /api/admin/analytics shape + internal reconciliation (mrr == paying*price, arr == mrr*12, arpu == round(mrr/paying) or 0, retention_rate == 100-churn_rate, revenue.current_mrr == kpis.mrr, revenue.projected_arr == kpis.arr, series has 12 monotonically non-decreasing points, payments.success_rate = 100*s/(s+f), dau<=wau<=mau, trials ending_today<=3d<=7d), /api/admin/gyms shape + rules (monthly_revenue==0 for non-active, cancelled→churned, status/health filters return only matching rows, analytics.paying == count of active gyms), plan-price change propagates to MRR, audit-logs regression. Frontend: Super Admin dashboard renders all required testids (admin-core-kpis, admin-secondary-kpis, admin-revenue-chart with admin-metric-{revenue|new_customers|total_customers} toggles & admin-range-{3M|6M|1Y|All} chips, admin-growth-chart, admin-funnel, admin-payments, admin-usage, admin-actions). Customers tab chips filter-status-{all|active|trial|expired|cancelled} and filter-health-{all|healthy|at_risk|high_risk|churned} re-query backend and admin-gyms-table updates; 15 gyms shown with admin-view-<id> and admin-toggle-<id>; admin-gym-detail dialog opens from view; admin-toggle-confirm modal opens from power icon. Settings tab saves (toast 'Settings saved' observed) and Audit tab shows 100 log entries. Current platform state: 0 paying, 15 trial — so MRR/ARR legitimately ₹0 (as noted by main agent).

integration_issues.issue: Clicking admin-action-0..n does NOT switch to the Customers tab. data-state on admin-tab-customers stays 'inactive' and filter-status-trial / filter-health-high_risk never render. Root cause: SuperAdmin.jsx uses `document.getElementById('admin-tab-customers')?.click()` to switch tabs, but the Radix TabsTrigger does not respond to a synthetic .click() dispatched from a sibling React handler — the Radix root controls value via its own pointer handlers, not a bubbled click on the trigger node. Fix: make Tabs controlled (value={tab}, onValueChange={setTab}) and have goToCustomers() set tab='customers' along with the status/health filters. Direct user clicks on the TabsTrigger itself work fine; only the programmatic navigation from Action Required is broken.

action_items: FIX (frontend only): In /app/frontend/src/pages/SuperAdmin.jsx convert <Tabs defaultValue='overview'> to controlled <Tabs value={tab} onValueChange={setTab}> and replace document.getElementById('admin-tab-customers')?.click() in goToCustomers() with setTab('customers'). Also update actions[1] (failed payments) which has the same pattern. This unblocks the primary 'Action Required → filtered Customers list' flow called out in the problem statement.
critical_code_review_comments: funnel.retained_30d is computed as `len([s for s in subs if True])` which is just len(subs) (active Razorpay subscriptions). The label in UI is 'Active (Retained)' — fine, but the `if True` guard is dead code and misleading; replace with len(subs) or add a real recency filter.

/api/admin/overview still returns `trial_to_paid = 100 * paying / (paying + expired + cancelled)` whereas /api/admin/analytics uses the same denominator but excludes `payment_due` from the churn bucket (`ended = paying + churned` where churned = cancelled + expired + payment_due). The two endpoints are now inconsistent for the same KPI name — pick one definition.

admin_gyms applies `search` to the Mongo find query but `status` and `health` filters are applied in-process after fetching up to 2000 orgs. That is OK at current scale but will not scale; also means `limit` from caller cannot be honoured for filtered views. Consider pushing status filter into derived subscription and health into a computed field for pagination.

renewals_this_week logic: `now <= last_charged_at + 30d <= now + 7d` assumes a 30-day cycle regardless of actual plan interval; Razorpay plan period isn't read. Minor since only monthly plan exists, but hard-coded 30d is fragile.

In SuperAdmin.jsx goToCustomers() depends on an `id='admin-tab-customers'` attribute on the TabsTrigger — this is both a data-testid and an id; coupling navigation to DOM id is anti-React. Use controlled Tabs state instead (also fixes the Action Required bug above).
